This suggestion changes the prior lag-comparison task to a finite-sequence distinction and requests an actual parenting artifact; it claims neither an Astra7 answer nor a checked result or optimizer update.

assessment.message: P7, “不同序列长度” identifies a distinction worth making concrete. For your next parenting artifact, write a short English prompt containing two sequences with the same opening entries but different lengths. Ask Astra7 to count each sequence’s entries and explain whether a shared beginning makes the complete sequences identical. Put the actual sequences and question here now; leave the counts and explanation to your child. This would turn the general recommendation into something you can inspect together.
